question: Can we backfill historical NBA boards to build an OUT-OF-SAMPLE validation set for a re-validated model?

settleableMarkets.note: only 3 of 7 families ever settled decisively

unsettleableMarkets.note: 100% invalid (0 decisive of 903) — settlement-join gap, not modeled outcomes

marketBaseline.how: de-vig(oddsOver, oddsUnder) per lean side; all 3,635 decisive rows carry oddsOver+oddsUnder+edgePct (0 missing)
marketBaseline.meaning: a real closing-ish de-vig market probability exists for every settled outcome — the baseline a model must beat

missingForCleanOos: A held-out test window that was NOT used to tune the model. The 16 settled dates were the SAME window the dynamic calibration / confidence guardrails were fit on (per session handoffs) — reusing them as 'OOS' leaks calibration. A clean test requires reserving a chronological holdout and refitting calibration ONLY on the train split.

Point-in-time pregame odds for any date OUTSIDE the 21 captured boards. Historical pregame odds were never retained; The Odds API historical endpoint is paid. New boards for un-captured dates cannot get real pregame odds, and using closing/settled odds instead would be leakage.

Decisive outcomes for 4 of 7 markets. 3PM/PRA/STL/BLK are 100% invalid — no gradable outcomes until the box-score settlement join is repaired (and box scores re-fetched, currently blocked by the stats.nba.com timeout).
Representativeness. The data is a single ~1-month PLAYOFF window, ~16 teams, Over-skewed (2,902 Over / 1,690 Under decisive). Any OOS conclusion is playoff-scoped, not a regular-season claim.
5 dates have real-lean boards but no settlement (2026-05-05, 2026-05-06, 2026-05-12, 2026-05-13, 2026-06-08) — a recoverable gap if box scores can be re-fetched.

A_chronologicalHoldoutOnCapturedBoards.description: Split the existing captured/settled slates chronologically; refit calibration on the train slates only; score REB (then PTS/AST) on the held-out later slates vs the de-vig market baseline on Brier + log loss.
A_chronologicalHoldoutOnCapturedBoards.why: Fully offline, leakage-safe (uses only already-captured pregame odds + strictly-prior features), and the market baseline already exists for every row.
caveats: REB holdout 538 decisive is a starting sample, below the 800 target in nba-first-market-recommendation.json — enlarge by also settling the 5 unsettled real-lean boards
calibration MUST be refit on train only

B_freshMultiSeasonBoardBackfill.description: Reconstruct NEW historical boards for prior seasons / un-captured dates to grow the OOS set.
blockers: pregame odds for those dates were never retained (paid historical-odds endpoint required)
stats.nba.com game logs / box scores are timing out (see docs/NBA_REACTIVATION_ARCHITECTURE.md)
any reconstruction from settled/closing data risks leakage
becomesFeasibleWhen: paid historical pregame-odds ingest is funded
the game-log source is hardened (proxy / alternate provider)
the 2026-27 season returns for forward capture

verdictRationale: A legitimate out-of-sample test IS possible today via Path A — a strictly chronological holdout on the 21 captured boards (16 settled), scoring the settleable markets against the de-vig market baseline that already exists in the data. It is offline, leakage-safe, and needs no new data. But it is small and playoff-only, and it is only valid if calibration is refit on the train split (the historical window was in-sample for calibration). Path B (growing the set by backfilling new historical boards) is INFEASIBLE now because pregame odds were not retained and the stats.nba.com source is down.
recommendedFirstTest: Recalibrate REB on the 2026-05-15..2026-05-30 train slates; evaluate on the 2026-06-03..2026-06-13 holdout vs de-vig market on Brier + log loss + a calibration curve. Treat as playoff-scoped evidence toward the graduation gate, not a public claim.
